actions.action: Require valid source links before saving definitions
actions.mechanism: Enforce source attachment in storage, so neither editor forms nor imports can create ungrounded definitions.
actions.implementation: Require each definition to reference at least one existing supplied passage ID. Reject missing references and restrict deletion of referenced passages.
actions.check: Attempt saves through forms and imports with absent, unknown, and valid passage IDs; only valid references should succeed.
actions.risk: A valid reference does not establish that the passage supports the wording.

actions.action: Preserve wording through immutable definition revisions
actions.mechanism: Append revisions rather than overwriting text, retaining the exact wording and source bindings of earlier definitions.
actions.implementation: Store revision IDs, predecessor IDs, wording, and passage IDs. Make edits create new revisions; label older revisions without deleting them.
actions.check: Revise a disputed definition twice; verify all three texts and their original source links remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Revision history alone can conceal alternatives unless the interface exposes them.

actions.action: Represent disagreement as explicit competing definitions
actions.mechanism: Separate competing claims from revision history, preventing editorial preference from erasing a live alternative.
actions.implementation: Create dispute groups containing independently source-linked definition revisions. Record disagreement notes and editorial decisions separately; retain every competing text after resolution.
actions.check: Mark one wording preferred, then resolve the dispute; confirm readers can still inspect every alternative and its source.
actions.risk: A preferred label may appear authoritative; identify it as an editorial choice.

actions.action: Show definitions, passages, and disagreements together
actions.mechanism: A contextual inspection view makes evidence and competing wording accessible without requiring readers to reconstruct their relationships.
actions.implementation: Add an inspect control beside each definition that opens its supplied passages, passage IDs, and competing definitions with clear labels.
actions.check: Using keyboard navigation, open a disputed entry and reach every competing wording and its complete linked passage.
actions.risk: Truncated excerpts can obscure qualifications; always provide access to the full passage.

actions.action: Distinguish scoped meanings from direct contradictions
actions.mechanism: Explicit applicability notes let different meanings coexist without automatically treating every wording difference as a conflict.
actions.implementation: Add optional scope notes with supplied passage IDs. Let editors classify relationships as overlapping, distinct-scope, or disputed while preserving both definitions.
actions.check: Create two scoped meanings and one disputed pair; verify classifications, wording, and supporting passages remain visible independently.
actions.risk: Unsupported scope labels can manufacture agreement; allow readers to inspect their evidence.

actions.action: Keep competing definitions visible in search
actions.mechanism: Term-level result grouping prevents ranking or deduplication from silently suppressing less-preferred definitions.
actions.implementation: Index every retained wording. Group results by term, display alternative and dispute counts, and provide direct links to matching wording and passage IDs.
actions.check: Search a phrase unique to a nonpreferred definition; confirm that wording is reachable and its competing definitions are disclosed.
actions.risk: Large histories can overwhelm results; distinguish historical revisions from current alternatives.

actions.mechanism: Bundling definitions with supplied passages preserves inspectability when a reader lacks access to the editing application.
actions.implementation: Generate a read-only HTML snapshot containing definition revisions, competing wording, disagreement notes, and passage-ID anchors with full supplied text.
actions.check: Open the snapshot offline; follow every definition’s source links and verify each exported dispute includes all competing wording.
actions.risk: Snapshots become stale; display their creation time and included revision IDs.
